{
  "extract_plan": {
    "chunk_summary": "Statistics Canada Quality Guidelines phase 5 (Profile and prepare data): describes the phase and its seven sub-processes (profile; standardize/classify/code; edit and impute; adjust and reweight; derive variables; assess impact; finalize files), defines imputation, the PUMF and the shared file, and lists normative guidelines for data profiling and data coding."
  },
  "concepts": [
    {
      "id": "c1",
      "name": "Data profiling and preparation",
      "aliases": ["Profile and prepare data"],
      "description": "The phase that uses profiling to identify incomplete, incorrect, inaccurate or irrelevant data in the original source and then modifies, corrects or suppresses it so the acquired source information is consistent and ready for the next phases.",
      "anchor": "Data profiling and preparation involves",
      "location": "statcan-quality-guidelines-6th-edition#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "c2",
      "name": "Profile data",
      "aliases": ["Data profiling"],
      "description": "Sub-process 5.1: reviewing and gathering as much information as possible about the acquired data to determine and profile their different characteristics.",
      "anchor": "5.1. Profile data",
      "location": "statcan-quality-guidelines-6th-edition#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "c3",
      "name": "Standardize, classify and code",
      "aliases": ["Data coding"],
      "description": "Sub-process 5.2: standardizing the structure, format, and sets of codes and abbreviations of source data variables, and assigning numerical or alphanumerical values to text responses according to a predetermined classification system.",
      "anchor": "5.2. Standardize, classify and code",
      "location": "statcan-quality-guidelines-6th-edition#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "c4",
      "name": "Edit and impute",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Sub-process 5.3: a logical continuation of data profiling that occurs when data are reported as incorrect, missing or unreliable.",
      "anchor": "5.3. Edit and impute",
      "location": "statcan-quality-guidelines-6th-edition#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "c5",
      "name": "Adjust and reweight",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Sub-process 5.4: adjusting survey weights, occurring mainly in statistical sampling survey processes when the observed sample is smaller than the sample initially selected.",
      "anchor": "5.4. Adjust and reweight",
      "location": "statcan-quality-guidelines-6th-edition#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "c6",
      "name": "Derive new variables and statistical units",
      "aliases": ["Derivation"],
      "description": "Sub-process 5.5: creating new variables and statistical units from the values obtained from source data by applying mathematical formulas or different modelling assumptions.",
      "anchor": "5.5. Derive new variables and statistical units",
      "location": "statcan-quality-guidelines-6th-edition#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "c7",
      "name": "Assess and document the impact of changes",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Sub-process 5.6: assessing and documenting the impact of the transformations carried out in the previous five sub-processes, including how they affected data quality.",
      "anchor": "5.6. Assess and document the impact of changes",
      "location": "statcan-quality-guidelines-6th-edition#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "c8",
      "name": "Finalize data files",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Sub-process 5.7: combining the results of the previous six sub-processes to produce the final processing file used for the next phase.",
      "anchor": "5.7. Finalize data files",
      "location": "statcan-quality-guidelines-6th-edition#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "c9",
      "name": "Imputation",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Assigning replacement values to missing, invalid or inconsistent data rejected in the data validation phase.",
      "anchor": "Imputation is the process",
      "location": "statcan-quality-guidelines-6th-edition#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "c10",
      "name": "public use microdata file (PUMF)",
      "aliases": ["PUMF"],
      "description": "One of the dissemination files; an abridged version of the master file assessed to eliminate all reasonable risks of identifying respondents.",
      "anchor": "public use microdata file (PUMF)",
      "location": "statcan-quality-guidelines-6th-edition#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "c11",
      "name": "master file",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "One of the data files in the dissemination database, of which the PUMF is an abridged version.",
      "anchor": "namely the master file",
      "location": "statcan-quality-guidelines-6th-edition#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "c12",
      "name": "shared file",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "A dissemination file containing only the records of respondents who consented to have their data shared.",
      "anchor": "The shared file contains",
      "location": "statcan-quality-guidelines-6th-edition#c0016"
    },
    {
      "id": "c13",
      "name": "survey weights",
      "aliases": [],
      "description": "Weights adjusted in the adjust-and-reweight sub-process when the observed sample is smaller than the sample initially selected.",
      "anchor": "adjusting survey weights",
      "location": "statcan-quality-guidelines-6th-edition#c0016"
    },

      "id": "c14",
      "name": "dissemination database",
